n96e8fa0e1b.headline: UPDATES: After IAEA Resolution Over Its Non-Compliance, Iran Steps Up Production of 60% Uranium
n96e8fa0e1b.summary: Iran is stepping up production of 60% uranium after the IAEA's 35-nation Board of Governors passed a resolution demanding an end to obstruction of inspections. The vote was overwhelming.
n96e8fa0e1b.why: Iran's nuclear programme drives sanctions, regional security risk and energy-market sentiment in the Middle East.

n54dce2d07f.headline: G7 countries, Australia set Russian oil price cap at $60 per barrel
n54dce2d07f.summary: G7 countries and Australia agreed to set a price cap of $60 per barrel on Russian oil. The move followed a political agreement reached by EU members after resistance from Poland.
n54dce2d07f.why: Price caps on Russian crude limit the revenue Moscow can earn from seaborne oil sales, and they shape global crude flows and benchmark prices.
n54dce2d07f.why_moved: The price cap sets a ceiling on what Western buyers and service providers can pay for Russian oil, which affects global crude supply and pricing expectations.

n34306e1493.summary: A Ukrainian official stated that lowering the Russian oil price cap to $30 would accelerate damage to Russia's economy.
n34306e1493.why: Price caps on Russian oil aim to limit revenue funding Russia's war efforts, affecting global oil markets and geopolitical dynamics.

nb156668a5f.summary: Economists expect India to achieve nearly 7% GDP growth this fiscal year despite global headwinds, though challenges remain.
nb156668a5f.why: India's economic growth influences its market performance, currency, and investment climate.

n3850bf9885.headline: India on track to hit $100 bn  in remittances: World Bank
n3850bf9885.summary: India is expected to be the first country to receive $100 billion in remittances during 2022, according to the World Bank.
n3850bf9885.why: Remittances are a significant source of foreign exchange for India, impacting its balance of payments and currency stability.

nb486d93701.why: Strong real estate sales reflect economic recovery and increased investor and consumer confidence in India.

n9392a313e1.summary: One year after COP26, Scottish leaders are urged to intensify efforts to combat climate change and meet environmental targets.
n9392a313e1.why: Government climate policies influence energy markets, investments, and regulatory environments.

n7ac07b4b54.why: Disney's leadership change aims to stabilize revenue and shareholder value, impacting its stock and media industry outlook.

nc7f8ecc9a5.summary: Pakistan made a USD 1 billion Sukuk bond payment before schedule, helping to avoid default amid depleted foreign reserves.
nc7f8ecc9a5.why: Timely debt repayment supports Pakistan's creditworthiness and stability, influencing investor confidence and sovereign risk.
